Subject: Post-demo recap: deployment constraints (SSO / KMS / logging)

Hi Cara / Alex — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our call and a few next steps so we can map the right deployment option for FintechCo.

Key items you flagged:
- SSO: SAML 2.0 identity provider + SCIM provisioning for automated user sync
- KMS/HSM: requirement for customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM-backed key storage for encryption at rest
- Logging & retention: 7 years of audit logs, ability to export/forward logs to your Splunk/SIEM, and US-only data residency

What this usually means for customers:
- Hosted API: fastest to get started but cannot support customer-managed HSM/BYOK or guaranteed log forwarding to your SIEM
- Dedicated: isolated GPU pools and VPC peering can meet some network/residency needs; limited BYOK options depending on contract; often requires additional controls for HSM
- Private (VPC/on-prem): fully supports BYOK and customer HSM integration, long-term log retention and direct SIEM forwarding; higher setup and contract complexity

I've attached our deployment options summary (redwood_deployment_options.pdf) and a short matrix we'll populate once you confirm priorities. Proposed next step: 30-min technical deep dive next week with your security and infra teams to validate BYOK/HSM integration details. Are you available Tue/Wed next week?

—Marissa

Thanks Marissa — appreciate the clear summary. A few clarifications from our side so you can recommend Dedicated vs Private: 

1) SSO: We require SAML 2.0 for auth and SCIM for provisioning. We will need to sync group membership from Okta and enforce role-based access.
2) KMS/HSM: Critical — we need customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM-backed key storage. Keys must be under our control (rotation policy enforced by us) and accessible only to our security team.
3) Logging & retention: All audit logs (API calls, admin actions, authentication events) must be retained for 7 years. We want near-real-time forwarding into Splunk (via syslog/HTTPS).
4) Data residency: All logs and persisted data must stay in US regions.

Given that list, is there a path where Dedicated can meet (2) and (3) with reasonable SLAs, or does this effectively require a Private VPC/on-prem deployment? Also looping in Procurement — we will need a rough cost delta estimate (Dedicated vs Private) and an expected timeline for Private (onboarding, certs, network setup).

Thanks — happy to schedule a technical call. Our security lead (cc'd) can join.

Hi Cara — great questions. Short answers first, then proposed next steps.

Short answers:
- Hosted API: will not satisfy BYOK/HSM or 7-year secure retention requirements. Not recommended for regulated fintech workloads.
- Dedicated: can meet network isolation and US residency requirements; depending on contract we can support customer-managed KMS via a wrapped-key approach but native HSM integration (customer-controlled HSM appliances) typically requires Private.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): recommended if you need HSM-backed BYOK, strict long-term retention, and direct log egress to your Splunk instance under your control.

Notes on Dedicated vs Private for your items:
- SSO: both Dedicated and Private support SAML + SCIM; we have an Okta integration pattern we can share.
- KMS/HSM: Dedicated supports KMS integrations (customer-managed keys in cloud KMS with key-wrapping) but not customer-managed on-prem HSM appliances. If the requirement is for an HSM you control on-prem, Private is the path.
- Logging & retention: Dedicated can stream logs to your SIEM and configure retention policies, but guarantees for multi-year legal retention and archival to your controlled storage are only available on Private deployments (we can configure direct S3 archival or on-prem storage).

Next steps:
1) I attached a deployment_mode_matrix.xlsx that maps features to Hosted/Dedicated/Private — I'll populate it with the details above and our recommended architectures.
2) Technical deep dive: 30–45 min with your security/infra + our solutions engineering (include Vivek for HSM/KMS details). Proposed slots: Tue 2026-07-07 10:00–10:45 PDT or Wed 2026-07-08 13:00–13:45 PDT. Let me know which works.
3) I'll request a pricing delta (Dedicated vs Private) from Sales Ops and include an estimate for onboarding time.
